name: Rigid Registration via Mutual Information Maximization
aliases: Local Rigid Registration with Mattes Mutual Information
definition: A 3D/3D monomodal intra-subject rigid registration technique for renal volumes, assuming the kidney remains rigid (only displaced, not deformed) during the 20-30 minute acquisition window. It uses Mutual Information (MI) as the similarity measure and Downhill Simplex for optimization, initialized by geometric moments.
summary: Rigid Registration via Mutual Information Maximization aligns medical volumes by maximizing joint intensity entropy, distinguishing itself from correlation methods by handling non-linear intensity relationships.
